title: He Gives Victory

questions.question: O God, you have rejected us, broken our defenses; you have been what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:1 (ESV): "O God, you have rejected us, broken our defenses; you have been angry; oh, restore us."

questions.question: You have made the land to quake; you have torn it open; repair its breaches, for it does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:2 (ESV): "...repair its breaches, for it totters."

questions.question: You have made your people see hard things; you have given us wine to drink that made us do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:3 (ESV): "you have given us wine to drink that made us stagger."

questions.question: You have set up a banner for those who fear you, that they may flee to it from the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:4 (ESV): "...that they may flee to it from the bow."

questions.question: That your beloved ones may be delivered, give salvation by your right hand and answer whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:5 (ESV): "...give salvation by your right hand and answer us!"

questions.question: God has spoken in his holiness: "With exultation I will divide up Shechem and portion out the Vale of what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:6 (ESV): "...and portion out the Vale of Succoth."

questions.question: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet; Judah is my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:7 (ESV): "Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet; Judah is my scepter;"

questions.question: Moab is my washbasin; upon Edom I cast my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:8 (ESV): "Moab is my washbasin; upon Edom I cast my shoe;"

questions.question: Over Philistia I shout in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:8 (ESV): "over Philistia I shout in triumph."

questions.question: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:9 (ESV): "Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?"

questions.question: Have you not rejected us, O God? You do not go out, O God, with our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:10 (ESV): "You do not go out, O God, with our armies."

questions.question: Oh, grant us help against the foe, for vain is the salvation of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:11 (ESV): "for vain is the salvation of man!"

questions.question: With God we shall do valiantly; it is he who will tread down our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60:12 (ESV): "With God we shall do valiantly; it is he who will tread down our foes."

questions.question: This Psalm is a Miktam of David, for instruction; when he strove with whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60 Title: "...when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah..."

questions.question: And when Joab on his return struck down twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 60 Title: "...and when Joab on his return struck down twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt."

key_verse_text: Oh, grant us help against the foe, for vain is the salvation of man! With God we shall do valiantly; it is he who will tread down our foes.
